title: pedicularis semibarbata subsp. charlestonensis
intro: Pedicularis semibarbata subsp. charlestonensis, commonly known as Charleston lousewort, is a plant species within the balm family (Pedicularis) native to the southeastern United States. Charleston lousewort has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and acting as an antifungal agent. The bioactive constituents present in Charleston lousewort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
